headline: Athens Stock Exchange returns to the international investment map – What Euronext Athens CEO says
summary: The Euronext Athens CEO says the Athens Stock Exchange consistently ranks among the best-performing markets globally by General Index returns. He says the exchange is returning to the international investment map.
why: The Athens Stock Exchange is Greece's main equity market, and its visibility affects foreign investor interest in Greek shares. Euronext operates the exchange as part of its pan-European network.
